messages: Mia Chen: Quick design check — updated compare table mock attached. Main asks: 1) make pinned version visible when collapsed, 2) badge color semantics (green = faster, orange = same, grey = unknown), 3) screen reader announcement for pin state. PTAL. Devon Patel: Looks good. Quick question: do we show the pin icon in compact rows? feels noisy when multiple pins. Samira Alvarez: I think yes — but only when hovered or focused. For keyboard users we need a persistent affordance, otherwise they can’t reach it. Anna Li: +1 to hover for mouse. For a11y we should expose a hidden label like `sr-only` 'Pinned to compare' when pinned. sample: ``` Pinned to compare ``` Jordan: For performance badges, prefer a numeric tooltip with percentile and sample size. e.g. 'throughput: +12% (n=1.2k requests)' so product teams can judge significance. Patrick K: If we change color semantics we must update the legend. People assume green = 'best' but green might mean 'faster but more expensive'. Consider icon + color to reduce ambiguity. Mia Chen: Good point. How about arrows + color? e.g., up-arrow green (faster), flat orange, down red (slower). And add a tiny cost-delta label where available. Devon Patel: Concern: table density — adding a cost delta per row will push layout. Maybe show cost delta in a hover card or the expanded details panel instead of the main row. Samira Alvarez: Agreed. Use the table to show core items only: model, version, perf badge. Expand opens a hover card/modal with cost + latency breakdown and small sparkline. Anna Li: For keyboard, ensure expand is reachable via Enter and that `aria-expanded` toggles. Also use `role=row` and `aria-selected` for pinned rows so screen readers announce the state. uxbot: Reminder: accessibility checklist link https://redwood.internal/design/a11y-checklist (also flagging color contrast for small badges). Mia Chen: Next steps: I'll update the mock to: persistent pin icon on the left for keyboard focus, hover-only pin affordance for mouse; perf badge with arrow+color; legend pill at the top of the table; hover card with detailed metrics (cost/latency/sparkline). I’ll push the new Figma by EOD. Patrick K: FYI: add tooltip text: 'Pin version — keep this model version in compare across pages' to avoid confusion when people expect version locking. Samira Alvarez: Also add microcopy for 'Unpin' confirmation? I think an inline undo toast is better than a modal confirm. Mia Chen: Love inline undo. Will add 5s toast with 'Undo' and update copy. Thanks everyone :heart:
